digest.component_or_area: RP-01 Pydantic AI seam integration and behavioral research
propositions: The existing Rebar structured-output orchestration must preserve historical behaviors around deterministic repair, schema extraction, retry ceilings, stop-reason fast-fail, budgets, fallback predicates, and failure taxonomy when migrating to Pydantic AI seams

An offline integration probe using Pydantic AI 1.107.2 native Agent/output/retry/limits/hooks seams (mocking only provider transport) must validate 19+ scenarios without live model calls and produce deterministic results

All material observable deltas between current Rebar and observed Pydantic AI 1.107.2 behavior must be explicitly classified as preserve, intentionally change, or explicit maintainer decision rather than silently inherited from either implementation

Four approved behavioral policies are: single operation-wide request budget (with raise-the-limit caveat), complete failed response on retry only when deterministically fit (else whole omission), bounded output-size retry with concise guidance, and terminal refusal/content-filter

Three approved post-Phase-4 behaviors are: aggregate every successful retry into single operation usage, re-raise only exact Rebar cause-chain error (never blanket UnexpectedModelBehavior), and use Pydantic requests as sole budget counter with candidate observability via trace events not usage fields

All historical ticket-derived scenarios must map to exact ticket aliases and all test-derived scenarios to exact test nodes, with current Rebar evidence from 290+ passing tests and research artifacts stored in .joe-janitor/ checkout-local paths
